Final categorization: EXCLUDED  
(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on modeling the future habitat suitability of an endangered species, the hispid hare (Caprolagus hispidus), using species distribution modeling (SDM). While it incorporates land use/land cover (LULC) variables such as built-up area, herbaceous wetlands, and shrublands as static inputs, it does not perform or focus on LULC prediction or simulation. Instead, LULC layers are held constant across time to isolate the effect of climate change. The study’s primary objective is ecological—assessing climate-driven shifts in species habitat—not predicting future LULC change. Furthermore, the analysis covers a transboundary region (India, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh), not a single nation at national scale, and thus fails the core inclusion criterion of explicit national-scale spatial implementation. It also fails the requirement that the primary focus be LULC prediction. Therefore, it meets exclusion criteria: “Species-specific/ecological focus unrelated to LULC” and “Local/regional/global/transboundary scale focus.”)
